checkpoint_loading: Read only selected_gate.pt for all nine original arm/seed runs, weights_only=True. Require source artifact hash, variant, integer seed/epoch, original protocol, normalized frozen-backbone state hash, strict gate-state keys/shapes, finite tensors, original trainable-parameter count and semantic state hash matching representation_diagnostics.selected. Epoch 0 remains an identity fallback, not a new model choice.
fit_evaluation: Recompute only the original manifest-eligible full-positive fit indices, in original order, with frozen original A and each saved selected adapter. Use source scaler, report_location_v1 inputs, evaluation batch size 16 and original region masks under no_grad. All model parameters are frozen/eval and tensor-state hashes must remain unchanged. No last/initial adapter inference, optimization, epoch ranking or new deployment router.
probe_replay: Restrict full-fit arrays to the original manifest-only 64-window probe. Check exact IDs/source indices/candidate masks/valid counts/prediction counts and reconcile with saved initial A and selected adapter probe error sums using the frozen tolerance. Publish maximum sample-region error-sum and pooled-MAE differences; full-fit batch16 and saved probe batch8 may differ numerically. Never substitute probe results for full-fit results.
phase_comparison: Fit and audit full-positive per-window errors support pooled valid-cell and equal-forecast-window estimates, per-region contributions, weekly summaries and original week/four-week-block bootstrap settings. New deterministic fit-calendar draws are descriptive in-sample. Selection adapters have saved aggregate MAEs only: report pooled point gains and valid-cell-weighted contributions, not invented equal-window estimates or weekly intervals. Publish later-period minus fit gain as a descriptive point difference; phases contain different windows, so no paired cross-phase CI, statistical causal diagnosis or automatic gate.
input_boundary: Reuse the complete frozen v12f Source reader and original train-only input fingerprints. Recompute eligibility from train manifests. Instantiate only FullPositiveDataset(train); no matched control dataset, validation or test array is loaded. Selection/audit outputs are read from hashed saved source arrays and aggregate metrics, not from new selection/audit model inference. Source checkpoint/data/control directories are read-only, and outputs may not be nested in them.
interpretation: Post-hoc fixed-model description of full adapter-fitting windows and repeatedly inspected selection/audit periods. In-sample fit behavior is not generalization evidence; phase differences confound calendar, sample composition and support. Original A/scaler already saw the wider train and A was old-validation-selected. Pointwise intervals condition on saved models and omit training/seed/multiple-comparison uncertainty. Do not infer overfitting, objective mismatch or architecture defects as causes, choose a winning seed, or weaken original selection rules. No raw test use or performance-win claim.
